- [LCYC.6.5] **Correlation-string inference for call
  cycles.** The call/response edge requires
  matching A's `as "c"` to B's
  `where r.corr == "c"`. If the correlation is
  computed rather than a literal, the check
  may be unable to prove the match. An unprovable
  edge is reported as "possible cycle, inspect
  manually" and does not fail the compile — the
  check rejects cycles it can prove ([LCYC.3.1]),
  never ones it merely suspects.
